01The person behind the code

More than a line of code.

I’m Sergio Alejandro Hernández Patiño, a senior software developer with over 6 years of experience in business software, consulting and technical leadership.

I combine .NET, React and Microsoft Power Platform to connect applications, workflows and data. My applied AI work includes Copilot Studio, agents and assistants, RAG and AI Builder, with technical review of the results.

My journey connects Colombia and Spain: development at CODESA and Intelecto, development leadership at Auto Control Empresarial and Microsoft 365 solutions at DynamizaTIC. I support solutions from analysis and design through testing, deployment, documentation and support.

Technologies and applications

  • .NET

    Backend services and REST APIs with ASP.NET Core. A foundation for connecting applications, processes and data.

  • C#

    Application logic, services and integrations within the .NET ecosystem.

  • React

    Component-based web interfaces connected to services and APIs.

  • TypeScript

    Frontend development with explicit types to describe data and contracts between components.

  • HTML & CSS

    Semantic structure, responsive design and useful interfaces with progressive enhancement.

  • Power Apps

    Canvas and model-driven apps that address business needs and processes.

  • Dataverse

    Business data, models and plug-in extensions for Power Platform solutions.

  • Power Automate

    Flows that connect systems and automate tasks, including desktop automation and RPA when required.

  • Power BI

    Dashboards and reports that make business information easier to explore and analyse.

  • PCF

    Code components that extend the capabilities of a Power Apps interface.

  • SQL Server

    Data queries, stored procedures and persistence for business applications.

  • Entity Framework

    Data access with Entity Framework Core and LINQ queries in .NET applications.

  • Azure

    Azure service integration, including App Service, Functions and Storage within software solutions.

  • REST APIs

    Contracts for exchanging information between applications and systems, using JSON data and authentication.

  • IA / AI

    Language-model and AI API integration in applications and automation, with technical review of the results.

  • OAuth 2.0

    Access authorisation for connecting services and working with APIs.

  • Git & GitHub

    Version control, change review and project source tracking.

  • Node.js

    Development tooling and static generation of Alejandro’sTech from JavaScript modules.

    Agents and assistants connected to business context and workflows.

  • RAG

    Knowledge retrieval to provide context and sources for a document assistant. Reviewing responses and their limits.

  • AI Builder

    Document processing and visual diagnostics within Power Platform applications and automation.

  • SAP & ERP

    Integrating applications with SAP and other ERP systems through REST APIs, custom connectors and OAuth 2.0.

  • SharePoint

    Lists and libraries connected to Power Apps and Power Automate; permissions and collaboration in Microsoft 365.

  • ALM & Pipelines

    Managed solutions, environment variables and connection references. Delivery across Dev, Test/QA and Prod with Power Platform Pipelines.

Cookies and privacy

What we store

The at_consent cookie remembers your choice for six months. Optional settings are stored locally for the same period. You can withdraw permission here: those settings will be deleted. Controls still work during your visit if you choose necessary only. If you enable the demo’s optional AI, the browser may store model files; delete them from the demo itself.
